name: CRM Adapter (Google Sheets)

parameters.jsCode:
const r = $('Resolve & Build Lead Row').first().json;
return [{ json: { leadId: r['Lead ID'], isNew: r._isNew, status: r['Status'] || '', dateCreated: r['Date Created'] || '' } }];

parameters.content:
This workflow acts as a CRM adapter using Google Sheets by receiving lead data, checking whether the lead already exists, creating or updating the lead record, logging the related communication activity, and returning the result to the workflow that called it.

Sub-Workflow, gets initiated after "Missed-Call Auto-SMS" and "Form Capture" workflows.

description: CRM Adapter sub-workflow — the only place that reads/writes Google Sheets. Upserts leads by Phone or Lead ID, mints LEAD-#### IDs, appends Communication Log entries, and returns lead metadata. Swap this workflow to move to GoHighLevel later.
